scope: Official AG News and DBpedia public classification. Allocator caps cover PyTorch CUDA allocations; host staging and host memory are outside them. Same-codec direct/native pairs and source/hash addressing controls remain distinct.
timing_interpretation: Descriptive observed ranges and balanced geometric means over three seeds, three cohorts, batches 1/32 and five allocator budgets. Repeats are not independent confidence bounds. A p50 slowdown above one means slower. Lossless capacity saving does not imply faster queries. FP16 comparisons to direct FP32 combine quantization and storage; the separate direct-FP16 comparison isolates storage over the same codes. CUDA allocator caps exclude host RAM and staging.
